MOD = 1000000007

def fast_pow(base, power):
    result = 1
    current = base
    pwr = power
    while pwr > 0:
        if pwr & 1:
            result = (result * current) % MOD
        current = (current * current) % MOD
        pwr >>= 1
    return result

q = k

elif k == 1:
    print(fast_pow(p, p))
else:
    cycle_count = 1
    while q != 1:
        q = (q * k) % p
        cycle_count += 1
    print(fast_pow(p, (p - 1) // cycle_count))
